parameters.query: SELECT cj.id, cj.topic, cj.draft_md, COALESCE(img.image_b64, gi.image_b64) AS image_b64, COALESCE(img.mime_type, gi.mime_type, 'image/png') AS mime_type FROM content_jobs cj LEFT JOIN images img ON img.id = cj.chosen_image_id LEFT JOIN generated_images gi ON gi.job_id = cj.id AND gi.is_chosen = TRUE WHERE cj.id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' LIMIT 1
